enrollment.caller_root: caller-owned operation/journal root only; no requirement to equal service roots
enrollment.service_roots: distinct serviceUID-owned0700 data/home/work roots with protected host-owned policy/ancestors; exact approved writes resolved by host

fixed_connector.response: bounded typed stream handle; connectedFD only with independently proven retained shutdown/limits across duplicate descriptors
fixed_connector.lifetime: owned watchdog; prior Access lease unchanged during renewal; bidirectional revoke/timeout/cancel and bounded reap
fixed_connector.effect_target: exact enrolled target_id: xpra-native or colibri-main; generation/action/route/session in canonical payload digest

stream_api.constraints: peer/context/session-bound opaque handle; sequence/replay checks; approved protocol frames only; root deadlines/byte limits and retained bidirectional shutdown; no caller URL/socket/descriptor authority
stream_api.grant_binding: each explicit operation uses fresh one-use effect grant keyed exact capability+operation+canonical target_id; frame grants also bind connector_id/generation/session/sequence/route/readlimit or payloadhash/bytes/deadline; original stream admission expiry never extended
stream_api.cleanup: root watchdog/revoke/expiry always closes owned stream without awaiting fresh caller grant; authenticated owner cancellation cannot be blocked by expired authorization. Normal grant-bound close cannot target sibling handle.

source_receipt.clearance: protected enrolledsourcepolicy +actualbrokerobserved/authenticatedingress or effectresult; no callerclassification; unknown=private/ineligible-public
source_receipt.transformation: each derived context inherits complete parent closure; no dropping/private-to-public relabeling

native_context_request.response: opaque context_handle and signedHostContext bound to authenticated enrollednativeprocess, sourceclosure and finalpayload
native_context_request.no_credentials: worker receives only nonsecret references/opaque peer-bound handles over protected IPC, never reusable secret in argv/env/profile/socketFD
native_context_request.per_effect: authority validates canonicalbody digest, fixedcapability/target/recipient/retry, freshcontext+one-usegrant at actualeffectboundary

native_wiring: reviewed installer-owned boundary adapter/overlay for actual core provider/tool/memory/aux/retry/background/delegation call sites; preserve pristine source. PluginContext/register(ctx) alone is not complete coverage. Missing wiring stays open, not permanentdefaultdeny completion.
evidence: actual installednative producer positiveflow plus hostile forged/stale/droppedparents/unknownsource/crossPID/childdelegation and mixedroots negativeeffects; fixtures/kernel/native/account distinctly labeled

process_inspect.resolution: root _handles registry only; registered systemd cgroup descendants via cgroup.procs, PIDFD/starttime identity; never caller PID/path/argv
process_inspect.failure: incomplete/changed generation/identity, inaccessible process, relaunch or renderer lineage unknown cannot authorize remote exposure; no merely mainPID-only success
process_inspect.sensitive_output: no environment/secrets/raw unrestricted argv; fixed sandbox evidence fields and bounded process count

operation_rule_migration: protected rule explicitly states one operation; duplicate/ambiguous keys and implicit wildcard/pair fallback deny. Re-enroll exact singleton legacy operation before activation, invalidate old policy revision/grants.
